authority.interpretation: Authorize Stage 5 independent review; do not pre-approve the candidate before the review result.

acceptance_criteria: Every Stage 4 contract, approval, marker, execution, source, and candidate hash verifies before visual review.
The independent reviewer inspects the exact candidate beside the approved model, protected front matte, and all four physical LH-003 source views.
The approved face, skin tone, hair, adult age presentation, pose, hands, waist, limbs, feet, and overall anatomy remain credible and materially preserved.
Front construction, fit, rose-cloud field, waistband, panels, binding, text, emblem, and wearer-relative artwork match source authority without mirroring.
Both visible side pockets and both side zipper closures are directly observable and correct.
The two rear pockets and rear zippers remain source-authority checks only and are not overclaimed as front-rendered proof.
No unintended drift appears in the model, face, hair, top, hands, background, product text, or non-garment pixels.
The independent review receipt uses the contract exact check set and pocket-evidence object and binds the current contract and candidate hashes.
The native vto_ooda.py review command returns PASS before manager founder-readiness can be recorded.
A failed check records a first-seen issue, retains quarantine, and permits no automatic retry.
An independent PASS permits only a separate exact-candidate founder decision; it does not grant scene-input authority.
No Stage 6 work, provider call, promotion, wiring, publication, or deployment occurs.

issues.failed_invariant: The candidate materially redraws the approved face and skin, including eyes, brows, nose, lips, jaw contour, tone, and texture.
issues.required_resolution: A newly and separately authorized recovery route must preserve the approved identity and non-garment pixels; the consumed Stage 4 attempt cannot be retried.

issues.failed_invariant: Shoulders, upper arms, hands, fingers, crop-top construction, and gray cyclorama/floor transition changed outside the authorized lower-body garment replacement.
issues.required_resolution: Use a route capable of protecting all non-garment pixels or provide a newly approved exact on-model source; no retry is authorized.

issues.failed_invariant: Neither visible side pocket resolves zipper teeth, slider, or pull strongly enough to prove both required zipper closures.
issues.required_resolution: A replacement candidate must directly and clearly show both side zipper closures. Rear zippers remain source-only in a front view.

issues.failed_invariant: Wearer-right rose bouquet/stems/cloud panel is absent, while wearer-left Love Hurts script and small emblem are partial or illegible.
issues.required_resolution: A replacement candidate must preserve complete unmirrored wearer-left and wearer-right artwork from physical source authority.

issues.failed_invariant: Substantial angular black side panels and red-white binding were reduced or geometrically changed from the physical sources.
issues.required_resolution: A replacement candidate must match the physical angular black panel and red-white binding geometry under a separately authorized recovery task.
